context: Asuka gives an evening lecture on study methods; Hina attends and asks questions.
purpose: Teacher in lecture register, naturally using formal connectives.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は、勉強の仕方について、お話しします。
lines.en: Today, I'll talk about how to study.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm professional clear delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 先生、よろしくお願いします。
lines.style: soft attentive teen girl voice, warm respectful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まず、暗記する場合、繰り返しが大切です。
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm instructive delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: curious teen girl voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。読書においても、同じことが言えます。
lines.en: Yes. The same applies to reading, too.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm explanatory delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ノートに書く方法も、いいですか?
lines.en: Is writing it in a notebook good too?
lines.style: soft teen girl voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 書くか、あるいは声に出すか、どちらも効果的です。
lines.en: Writing, or speaking aloud — both are effective.
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: つまり、自分に合う方法を選ぶんですね。
lines.en: So, I choose the method that suits me.
lines.style: thoughtful teen girl voice, soft warm understanding delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その通りです。すべての人に、同じ方法は合いません。
lines.en: Exactly. The same method doesn't suit everyone.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm affirming delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: すごく、分かりやすいです。
lines.style: bright teen girl voice, soft warm appreciative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そして、何より、続けることが大事ですよ。
lines.en: And above all, continuing is what matters.
lines.style: tender teacher voice, soft warm encouraging delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: soft determined teen girl voice, warm earnest delivery carefully
